plugins.name: research-spike
plugins.description: Run a reusable external research spike: tighten a topic into parallel workstreams, fan out web-research agents, synthesize findings, and save durable artifacts under docs/research-spike/.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: A task router for Claude Code: detect the task type (research · design · implement · debug · review · optimize) and run a pre-curated, model-tiered workflow — a shared sequential prelude that unblocks a parallel fan-out to cheaper tiers (Sonnet builds, Haiku scouts), then a convergence. Opus orchestrates by default; swap to Fable in natural language. Ships the /orchestrate router, an /orchestrate-workflows companion (run/manage/explain), pre-tiered subagents, a SessionStart doctrine, and layered repo+user JSON config.
